title: 第11章 我的秦小鱼第12章 横断山赵乾
lines: 就在我准备进入病房的时候，秦小鱼的父亲却拉住了我的胳膊。
“记住我跟你说的话，也记住你答应过我的，进去以后管好自己的嘴！”
秦小鱼父亲的话让我嗤笑一声。
“你放心吧。”
说完抽出胳膊，我走进了病房。
病房很宽敞，病床旁就是一扇落地窗，只是窗外那快下落的夕阳照射在病床之上，给给房间染上了一层垂暮之色。
眼前的老者也如同这夕阳一般，散发最后的光辉。
病床上的老者眼神很亮，虽然鼻子上还插着氧气，但是颤抖的手想要举起来，却已力不从心。
我赶忙上前一把握住了那颤抖的手。
“秦爷爷，我来看您了。”
我轻声说道。
秦老爷子露出了一丝微笑。
“小枫啊，秦爷爷对不起你，没有能去送我那老伙计一趟，这下好了，我那老伙计生气了，急着要带我走呢。”
秦老爷子有些打趣的说道。
感受着手里那已经干瘪的手，老爷子的手已经不再温暖了。
“秦爷爷，您会没事的。”
我只得安慰的说道。
秦老爷子摆了摆手，示意病房里的护士都出去。
看到人走完后，秦老爷子才说道。
“听说你跟小鱼吵架了？那天小鱼跑到我那里哭了很久，我问她她却什么也不说。”
说罢，秦老爷子用力的抬起手，摸了摸我的脸。
“小枫啊，你是个好孩子，我从小看着你长大，我了解你，小鱼是个好姑娘，希望你别错过了，有些困难不算什么的，能踏过去才是真男人。”
说完秦老爷子咳嗽了起来。
我赶忙让老爷子侧身，拍了拍老爷子的背。
“放心吧秦爷爷，我跟小鱼好着呢，没事的。”
听到我的话，秦老爷子笑着点了点头。
“可惜啊，可惜我看不到你们结婚生子了，我还想抱重外孙呢。”
看着老爷子眼中闪着希翼的光芒，那是对生命的渴望。
我不知道如何去安慰，只能转移话题。
“那个，秦爷爷，你不是喜欢酒吗？我在外地寻来了一瓶好酒，你肯定没有喝过！”
说完我拿出了身上的那个红色酒葫芦。
听到我说到酒，秦老爷子的眼中的光芒亮了起来。
“是吗？快给我尝尝。”
我点了点头，拿起一旁的一个纸杯，倒了一小点。
我只是想满足一个嗜酒的人最后的爱好而已。
刚拔开酒塞，一股异常浓郁的清香就飘散出来。
秦老爷子闻了一下，顿时沉醉其中。
“小枫啊，这是什么酒啊，说真的，我这辈子都没有闻到如味道的酒香！
快给我尝尝！”
我把倒出来的酒放在了老爷子的嘴边，老爷子一饮而尽。
“秦爷爷，您慢点喝！”
content_en:
Just when I was about to enter the ward, Qin Xiaoyu's father grabbed my arm.
"Remember what I told you, and remember what you promised me, to keep your mouth shut after you go in!"
Qin Xiaoyu's father's words made me laugh.
"Don't worry."
After saying that, I took out my arm and walked into the ward.
The ward is very spacious, and there is a floor-to-ceiling window next to the hospital bed. However, the setting sun outside the window shines on the hospital bed, giving the room a twilight color.
The old man in front of him was also like the sunset, emitting his last brilliance.
The old man on the hospital bed had bright eyes. Although there was still oxygen in his nose, his trembling hands were unable to lift up.
I quickly stepped forward and held the trembling hand.
"Grandpa Qin, I'm here to see you."
I said softly.
Mr. Qin showed a smile.
"Xiao Feng, Grandpa Qin is sorry for not being able to see my old man off. It's okay now. My old man is angry and wants to take me away in a hurry."
Mr. Qin said jokingly.
Feeling the withered hand in his hand, the old man's hand was no longer warm.
"Grandpa Qin, you will be fine."
I could only say comfortingly.
Mr. Qin waved his hand and motioned for all the nurses in the ward to go out.
After seeing the people leave, Mr. Qin said.
"I heard that you and Xiaoyu had a quarrel? Xiaoyu came to me and cried for a long time that day. I asked her but she didn't say anything."
After saying that, Mr. Qin raised his hand vigorously and touched my face.
"Xiao Feng, you are a good boy. I have watched you grow up since I was a child. I know you. Xiao Yu is a good girl. I hope you don't miss it. Some difficulties are nothing. A real man is the one who can overcome them."
After saying that, Mr. Qin started coughing.
I quickly asked the old man to turn sideways and patted his back.
"Don't worry, Grandpa Qin, Xiaoyu and I are fine. It's okay."
After hearing my words, Mr. Qin smiled and nodded.
"It's a pity. It's a pity that I can't see you get married and have children. I still want to have a great-grandson."
Seeing the hope shining in the old man's eyes, it was the desire for life.
I didn't know how to comfort him, so I could only change the topic.
"Well, Grandpa Qin, don't you like wine? I found a bottle of good wine in another place. You must have never drank it!"
After saying that, I took out the red wine gourd I had on me.
When he heard me talking about wine, Mr. Qin's eyes lit up.
"Really? Give me a taste."
I nodded, picked up a paper cup on the side, and poured a small amount.
I just wanted to satisfy an alcoholic's last passion.
As soon as I uncorked the wine, an unusually rich fragrance wafted out.
Mr. Qin took a whiff and was immediately intoxicated.
"Xiao Feng, what kind of wine is this? To be honest, I have never smelled anything like the aroma of wine in my life!
Give me a taste! "
I put the poured wine to the old man's mouth, and he drank it all in one gulp.
"Grandpa Qin, please drink slowly!"
title_en: Chapter 11 My Qin Xiaoyu Chapter 12 Zhao Qian in Hengduan Mountain
